title: Surface 2m Air Temperature Regular Lat-Lon Grid
description: Single-message WMO GRIB1 descriptor representing a 3x2 regular latitude-longitude surface 2-meter air temperature analysis in Kelvin.
code:
# WMO GRIB1 Surface 2-Meter Air Temperature Analysis
GRIB edition=1
  IS {
    edition = 1
  }
  PDS {
    tableVersion = 2
    center = 7
    parameter = TMP
    levelType = TGL
    level = 2
    date = "2026-07-15T12:00"
    decimalScale = 1
  }
  GDS {
    gridType = 0
    ni = 3
    nj = 2
    la1 = 42.0
    lo1 = -108.0
    la2 = 38.0
    lo2 = -100.0
    di = 4.0
    dj = 4.0
  }
  BDS {
    bitsPerValue = 16
    binaryScale = 0
    referenceValue = 285.0
    values = [291.4, 294.2, 297.8, 295.1, 298.6, 301.2]
  }
7777
